853:t_113:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand the situation. This unit shares $$ＡＧ$$'s assessment.」

853:t_113:15.en:
$$レド$$
「I see... I'll try it too, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

853:t_114:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If it will please you, $$ラケージ$$, I, $$ＡＧ$$... will work myself to the bone to serve you.」

853:t_114:6.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Then may I ask you for something?」

853:t_114:8.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Turn around and go full speed ahead. You need not return until I say you may.」

853:t_114:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-but then... $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will be unattended...」

853:t_114:10.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Pirates take what they want. Didn't you know that?」

853:t_114:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「E-even I must restrain myself when I weigh $$Ｄトレーダー$$ against my own desires...」

853:t_115:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is wrong, $$セツコ$$? You are so tense...」

853:t_115:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm happy to hear your congratulations, but why do you need to go out of your way to whisper them in my ear?」

853:t_115:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I do it because that is the custom...」

853:t_115:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. It is not something I decided on my own.」

853:t_115:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then I will also follow $$グローリー・スター$$'s methods according to our customs.」

853:t_115:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You who possess the proper qualities to bear the star of glory! You must always live with pride!」

853:t_115:17.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you have time to chase ladies' a... a... asses, put 120% into accomplishing the goal you set! That is $$グローリー・スター$$'s mission!」

853:t_115:19.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Thank you, Chief, $$トビー$$... I managed to do it too.)

853:t_115:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Thank you, $$デンゼル$$ and $$トビー$$... I got to enjoy a different side of $$セツコ$$.)

853:t_116:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll do your maintenance as a way of thanking you.」

853:t_116:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Uh... no... I am quite all right, thank you.」

853:t_116:7.en:
$$メール$$
「You don't have to hold back! Leave it to Darling, and even breaking 120% output isn't just a dream!」

853:t_116:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-you say that, but aren't you the one going at 120% output, planning to use $$ザ・クラッシャー$$ on my lovable body...?」

853:t_116:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh, good! I'll even give you a coat of wax!」

853:t_116:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(With such a forceful manner... he certainly lives up to $$ザ・ヒート$$...)

853:t_116:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I seem to be rather powerless against Darling.)

853:t_117:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks, though I bet it's just the thought that counts.」

853:t_117:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's that old 'If you feel sorry for me, give me you-know-what' deal. I curse the world for making me like this.」

853:t_117:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is probably your nature rather than your environment. Blaming others is unbecoming.」

853:t_117:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But rest assured. Becoming an ace pilot should increase the amount of funds you earn.」

853:t_117:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is more, in your case, $$クロウ$$, your personal skills should also increase the funds you earn.」

853:t_117:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that gets me motivated! I'll keep shooting 'em down left and right!」

853:t_117:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Of course, the funds earned belong to the entire unit, not to him personally...)

853:t_117:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Please keep up the good work, $$クロウ$$, for $c's coffers.)

853:t_118:4.en:
$n
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. I owe this to you too.」

853:t_118:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your smile is coming naturally now. Aren't you close to leaving your quiet-type days behind?」

853:t_118:6.en:
$n
「...So I haven't left them behind yet...」

853:t_118:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「People call you the quiet type because you can't just laugh it off at times like this.」

853:t_118:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you could answer with a joke as well, you would be perfect!」

853:t_118:11.en:
$n
「What kind of joke do you mean?」

853:t_118:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me see... If someone asks how you are coming along with leaving the quiet type behind...」

853:t_118:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you think of replying, 'All set, all muscle, all flesh, OK!'?」

853:t_118:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And strike a pose! Spread your legs for 'all set,' flex your biceps for 'all muscle,' and go dick-a-pop for 'all flesh'!」

853:t_118:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now... Join me! All set, all muscle, all flesh, OK!」

853:t_118:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You still have a long way to go, $n. Anyone who cannot cast off their inhibitions will never grasp anything from here on.」

853:t_118:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... a time will come when you must cast everything aside, after all.)

853:t_119:4.en:

「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. I owe this to you too.」

853:t_119:5.en:

「Your smile is coming naturally now. Aren't you close to leaving your quiet-type days behind?」

853:t_119:6.en:
